title: Localize the residual spin channel: rotation-correction, centering and capture-curl lesions
hypothesis: Reactive stabilization supplies contact-driven axial rotation that sustains success independently of the saturated spin drive.

prediction.rationale: An absolute 0.10 loss in sustained success would identify a substantial structural lever; D-050 lesioned the periodic stroke, not stabilization, and D-048/D-049 already close scalar tuning.

protocol.command: gpu run 'bash -lc "source ~/IsaacLab/source_env.sh && python scripts/run_shadowhand_spin_stages.py --config config/shadowhand_spin_stages.yaml --study r065_channel_lesions --log-dir logs/pen_spin/r065_channel_lesions"'
code_changes: New study module lares/envs/isaac_pen_spin/channel_lesions.py registered as --study r065_channel_lesions in scripts/run_shadowhand_spin_stages.py; settings in the research_protocols block of config/shadowhand_spin_stages.yaml. Parent config/pen_spin/r046_block3_incumbent (hashes checked), parameters unchanged, no fitting, R-062's source-substitution machinery.

Source audit before any episode: the parent's stabilization tensor mixes the centering term (center = center_gain * tanh(distance / center_length) * direction, from error = home - obj) with the rotation correction (tilt_gain * tilt_correction - swing_damping * tanh(transverse_speed / 4) * transverse_direction); the capture curl is extra_curl = capture_curl * ((1 - contact) + 0.75 * (1 - retained)). Each lesion is one audited substitution: rotation_correction_lesion zeroes rotation_correction (= 0.0 * (...)); centering_clamp sets error = 0.0 * (home - obj), the zero-error reference, so center = 0 while every other branch sees the true observation; curl_clamp sets extra_curl to 0.0 * (...), its no-loss reference. The study exits if any pattern does not match exactly once.

Offline identity gate, exact, before any episode: for each lesion the substituted source at its identity factor (1.0) must reproduce the parent's actions bit-for-bit (torch.equal) on the archived parent observations of D-050 (logs/pen_spin/r062_stroke_lesion/parent.npz, 80 cases x all in-play steps); no third process.
Arms, one fresh process each on the frozen 80-case Stage-3 diagnostic manifest (seed 4610): parent, rotation_correction_lesion, centering_clamp, curl_clamp. 320 episodes, zero LLM calls.

Primary (R-065): rotation_correction_lesion minus parent paired sustained success with the 95% t interval; threshold -0.10, falsified if the interval is wholly above -0.10, inconclusive if it crosses it. Secondary, same reporting: centering_clamp minus parent (R-066's question) and curl_clamp minus parent. Per arm: paired drop difference, win/loss/tie, failure split (drops, off-centre versus slow-spin tail failures by the final-centre and tail-spin reducers), in-play mean |spin| overall and on parent-sustained cases, drive and per-axis executed-action saturation over recorded in-play steps. Interpretation per arm as D-050: the channel carries spin if the loss is established, not carried by drops, and the arm's in-play |spin| on parent-sustained cases falls below 4 rad/s; a loss carried by drops is a retention channel, not a spin channel.
No arm is promoted or used for repair; this is channel localisation after D-050 and does not reopen scalar tuning, cold search, R-055 or imitation. Final test untouched.

falsified_by: The paired interval for stabilization-lesion minus parent lies entirely above -0.10; an interval crossing -0.10 is inconclusive, and a success loss explained only by additional drops does not establish the proposed spin mechanism.

approval.note: I accept the implementer's distinction between rotation correction and centering, and the shared-parent design: adding centering and capture-curl lesions incorporates R-066's question without another diagnostic protocol. Reusing scripts/run_shadowhand_spin_stages.py, config/shadowhand_spin_stages.ya

controls.parent: the unchanged frozen R-046 learner on the same 80 cases in its own process
controls.identity_gate: each lesion at factor 1.0 reproduced the parent's actions bit for bit (torch.equal) on all 23,484 archived in-play observations of D-050's parent run, before any episode
controls.source_audit: all eight structural patterns matched exactly once; the three lesioned sources are saved beside the results

notes: Primary, predeclared (rotation-correction lesion minus parent): +0.0375 [-0.037, +0.112] on 80 paired cases (17/80 vs 14/80; 6 wins, 3 losses, 71 ties); the lower bound is above -0.10, the predeclared refutation. Drops identical (13 vs 13), in-play |spin| on the parent-sustained cases 7.64 vs 7.06. The tilt and swing-damping corrections contribute nothing measurable to this learner's success or spin.

Secondary, centering clamp (R-066's question): -0.0625 [-0.127, +0.002] (9/80 vs 14/80; 1 win, 6 losses, 73 ties): a loss trend whose interval crosses -0.10 and just includes zero, inconclusive by the rule. Drops 14 vs 13 (+0.013 [-0.031, +0.056]); off-centre tail failures 24 vs 18; |spin| on parent-sustained cases 5.03 vs 7.06, still above the 4 rad/s threshold, and 8 of the parent's 14 sustained cases survive. Centering is a partial centring-and-spin channel, not the residual spin source on its own.

Secondary, capture-curl clamp, unpredicted: +0.1250 [-0.014, +0.264] (24/80 vs 14/80; 21 wins, 11 losses, 48 ties), a gain trend whose interval just includes zero, with an established reduction in drops (5 vs 13; -0.100 per case [-0.176, -0.024]) and far fewer off-centre tail failures (3 vs 18), while slow-spin tail failures rise (48 vs 33), overall in-play |spin| falls (4.16 vs 5.74) and only 3 of the parent's 14 sustained cases survive (|spin| on them 3.28). Removing the capture curl, the term that tightens the grasp when contact or centring deteriorates, changes the failure mode from drops and off-centre to slow spin: the parent's reactive curl is what loses the pen, and its spin on the cases it does sustain comes with that curl. The arm is a diagnostic lesion selected on this manifest; it is not a promotion and no success improvement is established.
Saturation: drive above 0.99 on 92-97% of recorded in-play steps in every arm (parent 96%); executed-action saturation 5-8% of components; recorded in-play steps only.

Localisation after D-050 and this panel: of the four channels lesioned on this learner, only the periodic stroke (D-050, about half the successes) and, weakly, centring carry success; rotation correction carries nothing; the capture curl is net harmful to retention. The spin that survives the stroke lesion is therefore not attributable to rotation correction; centring and the grasp-curl interaction remain the candidates, and single-channel lesions cannot exclude redundancy (the predeclared limitation).

Accounting: 320 Isaac episodes in four fresh processes, 0 LLM calls, about 4 min wall time; the offline identity gates ran on the CPU. Deviations: none; protocol.seeds was emptied mechanically after approval because the committed manifest carries seed 4610 (as R-053/R-058/R-060/R-062). Final-test split untouched.

verdicts.reasoning: Predicted that zeroing the rotation correction would cost at least 0.10 sustained success; observed +0.0375 [-0.037, +0.112] on 80 paired cases (17 vs 14; drops identical at 13; spin on the parent-sustained cases 7.64 vs 7.06). The lower bound is above -0.10, the predeclared refutation: the tilt and swing-damping terms carry neither success nor spin for this learner. The secondary arms localise the rest. Centring clamp: -0.0625 [-0.127, +0.002], a loss trend (9 vs 14, 1 win 6 losses) with more off-centre failures (24 vs 18) and spin on the parent-sustained cases down to 5.03, inconclusive by the rule and at most a partial channel. Capture-curl clamp, unpredicted: +0.125 [-0.014, +0.264] (24 vs 14, 21 wins 11 losses) with an established drop reduction (5 vs 13, -0.100 [-0.176, -0.024]) and off-centre failures 18 to 3, at the price of slower spin (48 slow-spin failures vs 33; |spin| 4.16 vs 5.74). The reactive curl is what loses the pen; without it the learner retains the pen and fails by spinning slowly. Confidence 0.85 because 80 pairs resolve the primary cleanly but leave the two secondary intervals touching zero.
verdicts.next_experiment: The capture-curl clamp is the first intervention on this learner with a success gain trend and fewer drops; it is a selected diagnostic, so the next step is a predeclared confirmation of exactly that one-line change against the parent on fresh paired cases under the strict promotion rule (promotion cases 10-39 plus fresh cases, prediction +0.10, drops not increased), which is what the direction asks before any repair. The residual spin after the stroke lesion is not the rotation correction; centring and the grasp-curl interaction remain candidates.

verdicts.reasoning: The named frozen parent was measured on the same paired cases, and the exact-action identity gates passed [logs/pen_spin/r065_channel_lesions/summary.json] [logs/pen_spin/r065_channel_lesions/identity_gate.json]. Rotation-correction lesion minus parent paired_success_difference was +0.0375, with a 95% interval of [-0.03714, +0.11214], wholly above the predeclared -0.10 refutation boundary [logs/pen_spin/r065_channel_lesions/summary.json]. This refutes the predicted decrease of at least 0.10 versus config/pen_spin/r046_block3_incumbent, but the interval includes zero, so it does not establish an improvement or prove the channel has no effect [logs/pen_spin/r065_channel_lesions/summary.json]. The lesion's mean absolute spin on parent-sustained cases was 7.64 rad/s, above the protocol's 4 rad/s mechanism criterion, so the proposed spin-channel mechanism is not established either [logs/pen_spin/r065_channel_lesions/summary.json].

Each arm's substituted source with its factor at the identity value must reproduce the parent's actions bit-for-bit (torch.equal) on the 80 x 360 archived parent observations of D-050 (logs/pen_spin/r062_stroke_lesion/parent.npz) before any episode; no third process. No arm is ever promoted. No LLM call; final test untouched.
